note: I-03 (sIPS format code on the envelope DocumentEntry) is a registry-level vector exercised by live scenario L-03 against a running registry.

V-02.description: None: valid attested issuance with evidence of the attestation action (option AI)
V-02.mutation: None: valid attested issuance with evidence of the attestation action (option AI)

I-01.description: Embedded IPS altered (dosage '5 mg orally once daily' -> '10 x 5 mg orally once daily'); visible pages unchanged; pages, projection and issuance record unchanged
I-01.mutation: Embedded IPS altered (dosage '5 mg orally once daily' -> '10 x 5 mg orally once daily'); visible pages unchanged; pages, projection and issuance record unchanged
I-01.why: The embedded octets no longer match the recorded digest (ENV-05) or the projection (XCH-02), and the pages no longer show the value the embedded source now carries (REN-02).

I-02.description: AFRelationship of the embedded IPS set to /Data
I-02.mutation: AFRelationship of the embedded IPS set to /Data
I-02.why: No associated file has relationship Source.

I-04.description: One medication entry omitted from the pages
I-04.mutation: One medication entry omitted from the pages
I-04.why: The omitted entry's required elements are not visible.

I-06.description: Text set in a non-embedded standard font (Helvetica)
I-06.mutation: Text set in a non-embedded standard font (Helvetica)
I-06.why: PDF/A-3 requires every font used for rendering to be embedded. ENV-10 is not expected: a standard font with a standard encoding has a Unicode mapping.

I-07.why: The file differs from the issued file.

I-08.description: Bundle.type changed to collection (record and envelope consistent)
I-08.mutation: Bundle.type changed to collection (record and envelope consistent)
I-08.why: An IPS Bundle has type document; the structural pre-flight fails before any validator runs.

I-09.description: Projection re-serialised with different white space
I-09.mutation: Projection re-serialised with different white space
I-09.why: The exchanged octets differ from the embedded ones.

I-10.description: Narrative-only section (plan of care) omitted from the pages
I-10.mutation: Narrative-only section (plan of care) omitted from the pages
I-10.why: The section title and its narrative are required and absent.

I-11.description: Dose on the pages differs from the source (dose 10 mg shown, 5 mg in the IPS)
I-11.mutation: Dose on the pages differs from the source (dose 10 mg shown, 5 mg in the IPS)
I-11.why: The entry is shown but its dose is not the canonical form of the source value.

I-12.description: Issuance record claims attested issuance without attestation evidence
I-12.mutation: Issuance record claims attested issuance without attestation evidence
I-12.why: Attestation is claimed and no evidence exists; with option AI the evidence obligation fails.

I-13.description: Legal attester in the source with no attestation evidence (the 0.2.0 behaviour)
I-13.mutation: Legal attester in the source with no attestation evidence (the 0.2.0 behaviour)
I-13.why: The source claims attestation for a preserved snapshot.

I-14.description: A problem code shown in the medication section
I-14.mutation: A problem code shown in the medication section
I-14.why: The code is carried neither by that section's entries nor by its source narrative.

I-15.why: An issuance is final, or amended for a correction.

I-16.description: Nested section; the nested entry's dosage timing omitted from the pages
I-16.mutation: Nested section; the nested entry's dosage timing omitted from the pages
I-16.why: A required element of an entry in a nested section is not visible.

I-17.description: ToUnicode maps removed from the embedded fonts
I-17.mutation: ToUnicode maps removed from the embedded fonts
I-17.why: The embedded subset fonts use an identity encoding, so without ToUnicode the page text has no Unicode mapping. ENV-10 is advisory: the failure is reported as a warning. REN-02 may also fail, because the Checker reads the pages through that mapping.

I-18.description: Attested issuance whose dose was changed after attestation; evidence unchanged; pages rendered from the changed source (option AI)
I-18.mutation: Attested issuance whose dose was changed after attestation; evidence unchanged; pages rendered from the changed source (option AI)
I-18.why: The attested content digest of the issued source differs from the digest that was attested.

I-19.description: Boundary: a Condition stage (disposition N) populated and shown; no inspection declared
I-19.mutation: Boundary: a Condition stage (disposition N) populated and shown; no inspection declared
I-19.why: The element has no canonical form, so automated checking cannot establish its fidelity: REN-14 is not-tested, and no obligation fails.
